mpi_headcount.description: Share of population multidimensionally poor (SAMPI headcount, 0-1)
mpi_headcount.expected_source: Stats SA South African MPI (Census 2011 / Community Survey 2016; Census 2022 when released)

piped_water_access.description: Share of households with piped water in the dwelling or yard (0-1)
piped_water_access.expected_source: Stats SA Census 2022 / General Household Survey

flush_toilet_access.description: Share of households with a flush toilet (0-1)

road_unpaved_share.description: Share of the municipal road network that is unpaved (0-1)
road_unpaved_share.expected_source: Rural Road Asset Management Systems (RRAMS); municipal IDPs

clinic_distance_gap.description: Share of households more than 5 km from the nearest clinic (0-1)
clinic_distance_gap.expected_source: Stats SA General Household Survey; DHIS facility list

school_infra_gap.description: Share of public schools with pit latrines or without a reliable water supply (0-1)
school_infra_gap.expected_source: NEIMS standard reports, Department of Basic Education

electricity_access.description: Share of households using mains electricity for lighting (0-1)

refuse_removal_access.description: Share of households with weekly refuse removal by the municipality (0-1)
